description: Permanently deletes one of the user's Snip.link links and its click history; its current and previous short URLs stop working within a minute and its current and previous endings remain reserved indefinitely, including for the same account. There is no automatic release, restore or reuse operation. Needs the user signed in to Snip.link. Confirm with the user first; to pause every ending instead, use update_link with disabled true.

link.description: The full short URL (https://go.snip.link/abc123 or https://snip.link/r/abc123), its ending (abc123) or its id. Full URLs are scoped to their host; they never select a same-ending link on another domain.

name: delete_link
title: Delete a link
